admin.title: Account eligibility
admin.subtitle: Each country maps to a balance-minimum bucket. Move a country between buckets to change the minimum balance applied to members from that country.

suspended.title: Your account needs attention
suspended.intro: Membership access pauses when an account falls below its requirements. Resolve the item below to restore access.
suspended.needBalance: Your account balance is below the {min} minimum for your region. Top up to at least {min} to continue.
suspended.needLots: You need at least {lots} lots traded in the current calendar month. You currently have {current}.
suspended.needBoth: Your balance is below the {min} minimum and you are short on this month's {lots} lots of trading activity.
suspended.stillShort: You are not eligible yet. Here is what is still needed.
suspended.restored: Access restored. Redirecting you to your dashboard.
